question: Which function key refreshes the page or document window in Internet browsers?
solution:
**The correct option is (1)**

F5

__**Concept:-**__

F5 is frequently used in numerous web browsers and other apps as the reload key.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• You can refresh or reload the website or document window by pressing F5.
